notes.title: Update from 11/28/2021
notes.content: The game balance has been changed. Added several models and sounds.

notes.title: Very big update
notes.content: We are pleased to present you a big update, adding 35 new levels, new enemies and new weapon. In order not to shock the old users of the game, we allocated a separate launch mode for updating the game when starting. If you want to try a new game, select the first item in the launch modes, if the old - any other mode.
